text:
Alicia (AE): Quick hit 1: NovaBank wants BYO-HSM + 30-day CMK rotation + offline dual-sign ceremony. Also: no public egress during POC, they demand a VPC connector. Need feasibility and cost. @Tom @Priya @Luke

Tom (Solutions Eng): Feasible. Two options: 1) VPC connector in their network (recommended) or 2) static NAT IPs (3 addresses) they allowlist. Connector gives stable source IPs and lower ops friction.

Priya (CryptoEng): Crypto notes: we never export private keys. Our flow: customer KEK in their HSM wraps DEKs. Rotation can be automated (rewrap) or manual ceremony. Dual-sign offline ceremony supported but requires documented MoM and a rollback plan. We need vendor cert chain and HSM operator contact.

Luke (SRE): VPC connector ETA ~10 business days (security review + infra). For POC we can do a temporary connector image they run in their subnet, or we host a connector in partner VPC under strict peering. Latency: expect +25-50ms per remote unwrap.

Alicia (AE): They also want per-op pricing and a ceremony facilitation fee. Ballpark numbers?

Tom (Solutions Eng): Ballpark POC: connector setup $3.5k one-time, hosting fee $750/mo, BYO-HSM ops surcharge $1.2k/mo. Per unwrap/sign = $0.035/op. Ceremony facilitation (remote) = $2k/ceremony.

SecurityBot: SSQ link auto-generated: https://redwood.internal/ssq/2275001234-novabank. Key answers: CMK supported, no private key export, mTLS/PKCS#11 onboarding, rotation supported (see section 4.1).

Priya (CryptoEng): Blocker: if NovaBank enforces strict per-source firewall rules AND wants our service to autoscale, we need a static NAT pool or connector inside their VPC. Otherwise autoscale will break. Also split-key escrow or multi-custodian ceremonies are SOW add-ons.

Alicia (AE): Action items: Luke to confirm exact ETA & cost delta for VPC connector; Priya to upload HSM onboarding checklist + ceremony template; Tom to draft SOW lines for pricing; Alicia to send SSQ and request vendor cert chain + CIDR + peak QPS. I'll coordinate CISO call tomorrow.

Luke (SRE): Uploading connector scoping doc now, will post ETA by EOD.

Tom (Solutions Eng): Drafting SOW lines and pricing sheet; tagging legal for review.
